description: A shell script for installing host system binaries along with required libraries, including functions for copying, moving, creating directories, symbolic links, and patching binaries.

methods.name: _cp
methods.description: Copies files with verbose option and error handling.

methods.name: _mv
methods.description: Moves files with verbose option and error handling.

methods.name: _md
methods.description: Creates directories with verbose option and error handling.

methods.name: _ln
methods.description: Creates symbolic links with verbose option and error handling.

methods.name: _runas_so
methods.description: Creates a shared object library that mangles argv[0] for specific runtime modifications.

methods.name: _patch_ldso
methods.description: Patches the dynamic linker to modify library paths in ELF binaries.

methods.name: _patch_glibc
methods.description: Patches glibc binaries for path adjustments in ELF binaries.

methods.name: should_be_patched
methods.description: Determines if a binary should be patched based on its type and executability.
